The processing facilities at the mine include the truck dump and primary crusher, secondary crusher, coal storage building, and railroad loading facility, which are connected by a series of covered conveyor belts. The capacity of these facilities is 14.0 million tons per year. Capacity can be increased to 19 million tons per year by expanding the coal storage from its present 50,000-ton capacity, upgrading the conveyors and installing an additional secondary crusher.
In addition, the plant site contains supporting facilities such as a shop and change house, boiler house, equipment storage building, office, laboratory, water treatment plant, and repair shop. Many of these would probably be enlarged to handle the additional men and equipment of expanded operation. Fuel and explosive storage would also have to be expanded.
